title: memories
description: One account's memory state, from a data export - since 2026-08-24 one object per file (the export placed it under memories/<account uuid>.json; the deposit hoists it to memories.json, the maintainer's ruling), where the pre-manifest export wrapped the same object in a single-element array.

memory_files.description: The account's memory files, the store claude.ai's memory_read tool reads: markdown files under /areas, /topics and the like. Present from the export of 2026-09-17; absent before.

path.description: The file's path in the store. Example: "/areas/yoga-corpus.md".

content.description: The file's markdown, front matter included.

updated_at.description: When the file was last written: ISO 8601 with microseconds and a +00:00 offset. Example: "2026-08-24T18:03:24.375476+00:00".
